use a Followers collection and counters on User"},{"relationship":"Comment\u2011User (author)","cardinality":"N:1","decision":"reference","rules":["R1","R5"],"reason":"author info shown on comment reads, copy username/image for hot reads"}],"collections":[{"name":"articles","source":"Articles","contains":"authorId + authorUsername/image (extended), tags array, favoritesCount, commentsCount"},{"name":"comments","source":"Comments","contains":"authorId + authorUsername/image (extended)"},{"name":"tags","source":"Tags","contains":"tag name only"},{"name":"users","source":"Users","contains":"followersCount, followingCount"},{"name":"favorites","source":"Favorites","contains":"compound _id {articleId,userId}"},"",{"name":"followers","source":"Followers","contains":"compound _id {userId,followerId}"}],"counters":[{"collection":"articles","field":"favoritesCount","counts":"Favorites","maintainedBy":"POST/DELETE /api/articles/:slug/favorite"},{"collection":"articles","field":"commentsCount","counts":"Comments","maintainedBy":"POST/DELETE /api/articles/:slug/comments"},{"collection":"users","field":"followersCount","counts":"Followers","maintainedBy":"POST/DELETE /api/profiles/:username/follow (as follower)"},"",{"collection":"users","field":"followingCount","counts":"Followers","maintainedBy":"POST/DELETE /api/profiles/:username/follow (as following)"}],"risks":["Extended author fields can become stale if username or image changes; must update all embedded copies on user update","Embedded tag array assumes a small bound; a surge in tags per article could approach document size limits","Denormalized counters require transactional updates; race conditions could cause off\u2011by\u2011one errors"]}

SOURCE TABLES:
TABLES (column:type, PK, FKs, rows):
- Articles(id:int, slug:string, title:string, description:string, body:string, createdAt:date, updatedAt:date, userId:int) PK=['id'] FK=[userId->Users.id] rows=1000
- Comments(id:int, body:string, createdAt:date, updatedAt:date, articleId:int, userId:int) PK=['id'] FK=[userId->Users.id; articleId->Articles.id] rows=2038
- Favorites(articleId:int, userId:int) PK=['articleId', 'userId'] FK=[articleId->Articles.id; userId->Users.id] rows=841
- Followers(userId:int, followerId:int) PK=['userId', 'followerId'] FK=[followerId->Users.id; userId->Users.id] rows=654
- TagList(articleId:int, tagName:string) PK=['articleId', 'tagName'] FK=[tagName->Tags.name; articleId->Articles.id] rows=1957
- Tags(name:string) PK=['name'] FK=[] rows=20
- Users(id:int, email:string, username:string, bio:string, image:string, password:string, createdAt:date, updatedAt:date) PK=['id'] FK=[] rows=200


DSL (schema.json): {"collections": [ {
    "name": "articles",                 target collection
    "source": "Articles",               one source row  ->  one document
    "id": ["id"],                       source PK column(s) -> _id (1 col: scalar, >1: {col: val, ...})
    "fields": [{"name": "slug", "from": "slug", "type": "string"}],      column -> field
    "embedArrays": [{"name": "tagList", "fromTable": "TagList", "parentKey": "articleId",
                     "valueColumn": "tagName", "maxItems": 20, "reason": "..."}],   child rows -> array of scalars
    "extendedRefs": [{"name": "author", "fromTable": "Users", "localKey": "userId",
                      "copy": ["username"], "reason": "..."}],             FK -> {id: fk, ...copied parent columns}
    "counters": [{"name": "favoritesCount", "fromTable": "Favorites", "parentKey": "articleId", "reason": "..."}],
    "indexes": [{"keys": {"slug": 1}, "unique": true}]
}]}

Rules: "id" must be exactly the table's PK columns. Map EVERY source column of a collection's source table
(PK columns go in "id", FK columns either in "fields" or as an extendedRef localKey). A junction table that is not
an embedArray must be its own collection. Add every index the query predicates need (equality fields, then sort field
with -1). Field types: int, long, string, date, bool.
Return JSON: {"collections":[...]}
